narrative: An employee's hand was pulled into the rollers of a laminator machine during a cleaning cycle, resulting in an amputation to their right index fingertip.
event: Caught in running equipment or machinery during maintenance, cleaning
notes: cleaning cycle may need the rollers to run; then guarding is the primary

narrative: An employee was setting up the electronic fuse on a non-lethal sting ball grenade. An electronic fuse is placed in the grenade and electrical wires are set up on the electronic fuse. The grenade went off as it was being set up for the test. The employee suffered multiple broken bones in his left hand, a laceration to the left hand, and multiple contusions to his stomach and chest.
event: Explosion, n.e.c.
source: Law enforcement and self-defense equipment, n.e.c.
notes: Explosive/pyrotechnic device assembly and testing (1910.109 explosives / 1910.119 PSM)

narrative: An employee suffered compression fractures to two back vertebrae while removing luggage from an overhead rack on a bus. She was hospitalized.
event: Overexertion in lifting-single episode
notes: Overexertion lifting injury; covered by General Duty Clause rather than a specific Part 1910 standard

narrative: An employee's left middle fingertip was amputated while reaching for a part on a press.
event: Caught in running equipment or machinery during regular operation
notes: Narrative does not specify mechanical power press (1910.217) vs. hydraulic press (1910.212)

narrative: An employee was walking down the stairway and tripped. The employee sustained a fractured ankle.
event: Other fall to lower level, unspecified
notes: Tripped while walking down stairs; treated as walking-working surface/tripping hazard (1910.22(a)) with 1910.25 as secondary

narrative: An employee removed a forged bolt and tossed it in a nearby keg. The bolt hit the rim of the keg, bounced back, and slid down between the employee's jeans and aluminized PPE pants. She suffered a third-degree burn on top of her left ankle.
event: Contact with hot objects or substances
source: Nails, brads, tacks, nuts, bolts, washers
nature: Third or fourth degree heat (thermal) burns
notes: Hot forged bolt slipped inside PPE pants; PPE fit/coverage (1910.132) and foot/ankle protection (1910.136)

narrative: A temporary employee was operating a magnetic crane to pick up and move a 6000-pound sheet of metal when the metal fell and struck the employee's left foot, fracturing the fourth and fifth digits.
event: Struck by object falling from vehicle or machinery-other than vehicle part
notes: Overhead/magnetic crane load-handling failure; 1910.136 (foot protection) also relevant

narrative: An employee was cutting wood on a table saw when the saw blade amputated his middle fingertip.
event: Struck against moving part of machinery or equipment
notes: Woodworking table saw point-of-operation guarding

narrative: An employee was on a work platform placing a tarp on a mulch trailer when the employee fell approximately 10 feet to the ground, suffering a head injury.
event: Other fall to lower level 6 to 10 feet

narrative: An employee was walking out of the plastic press, tripped and fell on corrugated steel (part of the platform) lacerating the right elbow and forearm.
event: Fall on same level due to tripping, unspecified
notes: Tripping hazard on walking-working surface/platform

narrative: Two employees were troubleshooting a pump and attempting to start it when an arc flash occurred. One of the employees was hospitalized for a second-degree flash burn to the left hand.
event: Direct exposure to electricity, unspecified
notes: Arc flash while troubleshooting energized electrical equipment

narrative: On 12/7/2020, an employee was pushing a die out of a hydraulic press when their fingers were smashed between the die they were pushing and a stationary plate on the press frame, resulting in a partial amputation of two fingertips. The machine was locked out at the time of the incident.
event: Compressed or pinched by shifting objects or equipment
notes: Machine was already locked out; pinch point while manually pushing die out of press falls under General Duty Clause rather than 1910.147

narrative: An employee was on a fiberglass step ladder, about 3 feet off the ground, capping off a dead air line. The employee fell off the ladder and suffered two broken ribs, a punctured lung, and head trauma.
event: Other fall to lower level less than 6 feet
nature: Internal injuries to organs and blood vessels of the trunk
body_part: Chest, except internal location of diseases or disorders

narrative: An employee was making a delivery at a customer's storage area when they were struck by a falling compressed gas cylinder. The employee's right humerus was broken.
event: Struck by falling object or equipment, unspecified
notes: Unsecured compressed gas cylinder fell and struck employee

narrative: An employee was descending the stairs in the boiler room. He reached the last stair before the landing and overstepped, causing his right knee to buckle. The employee sustained a torn patellar tendon that required surgery.
event: Climbing or stepping  up or down
source: Bodily motion or position of injured, ill worker
nature: Major tears to muscles, tendons, ligaments
notes: Overstepped last stair before landing; could be stair riser/handrail issue (1910.25) or simple misstep

narrative: An employee was unloading parts from the paint line when their heel caught on a cart near the work area, resulting in a hyperextended knee.
event: Trip over an object without fall
source: Bodily motion or position of injured, ill worker
nature: Traumatic injuries to muscles, tendons, ligaments, joints, etc., unspecified
notes: Tripping hazard from cart obstructing work area/walkway

narrative: While restocking a vending machine at a customer site, an employee began to fell unwell and suffered cramping. The employee was hospitalized for dehydration.
event: Exposure to environmental heat
nature: Effects of heat and light, n.e.c.
notes: Environmental heat/dehydration; OSHA cites heat hazards under General Duty Clause 5(a)(1)

narrative: An employee began to feel ill while dumping powdered caffeine into a vat. He was hospitalized, suffering from heart palpitations caused by the caffeine.
event: Exposure to other harmful substances, unspecified
notes: Chemical/substance exposure while dumping powdered caffeine; hazard communication and respiratory protection

narrative: An employee was descending a railcar when their hand became caught on part of the car/ladder. The employee sustained a partial amputation to their ring finger.
event: Struck against stationary object  n.e.c.
notes: Descending railcar ladder; hand caught on ladder/car structure

narrative: An employee was loading pipe onto a flatbed tractor trailer when a pipe began to roll toward the edge of the trailer. The employee jumped off the trailer to avoid the pipe and suffered a right lower leg/foot fracture.
event: Other jump to lower level, unspecified
notes: Unsecured pipe rolled off flatbed trailer during loading

narrative: An employee was cutting blocks of fish on a bandsaw when the employee's left index finger contacted the blade, resulting in a fingertip amputation.
event: Struck against moving part of machinery or equipment
source: Food and beverage processing machinery-specialized, n.e.c.
notes: Food-processing bandsaw (not woodworking, so 1910.212 applies rather than 1910.213)

narrative: On January 29, 2022, at 8:15 a.m., an employee was carrying machine parts for a milling machine while entering a building at the first-floor stairwell. The employee was tripped by the door and the machine parts he was carrying fell. As he tried to catch the parts, the employee's right hand was crushed between the parts and the concrete wall, resulting in lacerations to the ring finger and an amputation of the little finger.
event: Struck by object or equipment dropped by injured worker
notes: Tripped by door at stairwell while carrying parts; 1910.25 covers doors opening onto stairways

narrative: On August 30, 2017, an employee was cleaning out/blowing down a rotary airlock when the airlock caught and amputated his left middle and index fingers. The airlock was not locked/tagged out at the time of the incident.
event: Caught in running equipment or machinery during maintenance, cleaning
notes: Cleaning rotary airlock without locking/tagging out

narrative: An employee was setting up film on a small pack machine. The first bag became stuck on the tape and when the employee grabbed the bag, the machine started. The employee's left index finger contacted the machine's knife bar, resulting in an amputation of about 1/2 inch of the finger.
event: Caught in running equipment or machinery, n.e.c.
notes: Setting up and clearing jammed bag without locking out

narrative: An employee was using a radial arm saw to cut 12-inch pieces of wood when the saw cut and amputated the employee's left thumb tip.
event: Caught in running equipment or machinery during regular operation
notes: Woodworking radial arm saw point-of-operation guarding
